sloka: तेन चक्रेण मारीचो विष्णुनेव रणे हतः ।पतितो भूतले शैलात्क्षीणपुण्य इव ग्रहः ।। ७.१४.२२ ॥
transliteration: tena cakreṇa mārīco viṣṇuneva raṇe hataḥ ।patito bhūtale śailātkṣīṇapuṇya iva grahaḥ ।। 7.14.22 ॥

translations.english: Maricha was struck down in battle by that discus, as if by Vishnu, and fell to the earth like a planet whose merits are exhausted falling from a mountain.
